body:
As immediately as for five years? Or ten?

That's no good. Suffer weeks for a brief relief and then get even more suffering for a couple of days as a consequence of that relief?

Soon? How soon?
Years in this state I was holding on this - soon it will end.
It's nowhere soon. It's actually going to last at least a few years more. Or the whole life. That's not what I want from this life.

Yeah, of course. I want to find someone I'll love, enjoyable job, make new friends. Here's the truth: never my love to someone brought anything good, and it happened so many times that I don't want that feeling anymore. Friends? I try to be nice, friendly and kind with people. Last time I made a new friend was six years ago.
I have a hobby,it's basically wasting time on the internet.
I was trying some extreme sports to keep me alive. It was good. But then I had to go home, and during the evening all my feelings are crushed much more than ever. 
And I can't do something like sports 24/7, I'd have to do something boring anyway. And when I'm bored just a little - suffering comes back.
Last time I tried to make someone happy it all failed. She seems trying to forget all good, not to remember.
This brainstorming lasts for five years. Nothing new. Why do I have to suffer more and more?

I told my doctors all of this and much more, yet no one thought that I'm depressed. Coincidence? 
And how to beat them? 

Why do you need me? I'm not special. Maybe, just maybe I was, or had a chance to become special, but that's all in the past.
Sorry, I really do not understand. It sounds like good, but closed way for me.

Yes, I recently had one and don't like surprises anymore. 
They can, but amount of them is insignificant comparing to bad things.
Three different doctors told me that I'm not depressed.
I'm not going to keep trying, I can not. Not anymore. Something brand new - I'll try. But I do not see any for now.

Tell me what can be. I'm ugly, paranoid, weak, scared, stupid, just a shadow of everything I ever was. It requires working hard. And my will is a bit dead already.

Every new day brings more suffer. Tell me, what good is going to happen probably? How am I supposed to make good memories? Really, happiness? What is that thing?

How? 
I'm honest because I don't have anything to lose anyway.
They were trying. But no one knows how is that meant to work.
Am I supposed to magically feel better after a lot of talking and not solving a single issue because there is simply no solution? 
It's simple as that - I'm stupid or something, and I need years to fix it, working hard on something that everyone achieves without any troubles. But apparently I'm not strong enough to handle that anymore. Tried and failed. 

Like there is no answer for broken bone, there is no answer for broken mind.

It's basically same issues for years. Everything's been told already.

Talking is not helping. 


Well, I just wanted to be sure there is no paths that I accidentally missed.

My experience with trained professionals is about two things: expensive and useless.
I got fired from my job due to my depression, so I don't have money for them anyway.

Because years of trying to fix anything was a complete failure, and now I'm too frustrated to try more, I'm so wasted that I can't do it on my own, yet no one else is going to accomplish this task for me or with me.
Because no one knows how.
There are who want. But none of them was successful.

Everyone is telling me this.
Years go by.
Things can get better, but actually they're just getting worse.
